gloss: to marinate; to pickle; to soak

definitions.gloss: to marinate; to pickle; to soak in liquid
definitions.explanation: To immerse food in a marinade, brine, or other liquid for an extended period to add flavor or preserve it.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}をタレに{漬|つ}け{込|こ}む。
examples.english: Marinate the meat in the sauce.

examples.japanese: {一晩|ひとばん}{漬|つ}け{込|こ}んだ{野菜|やさい}は{味|あじ}がしみている。
examples.english: Vegetables marinated overnight have absorbed the flavor well.

examples.japanese: {下味|したあじ}をつけるために{調味液|ちょうみえき}に{漬|つ}け{込|こ}んでおく。
examples.english: Soak it in seasoning liquid to add flavor.

notes:
{漬|つ}け{込|こ}む emphasizes thorough soaking for extended periods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タレに{漬|つ}け{込|こ}む: to marinate in sauce
- {一晩|ひとばん}{漬|つ}け{込|こ}む: to marinate overnight
- {調味料|ちょうみりょう}に{漬|つ}け{込|こ}む: to soak in seasonings

RELATED WORDS:
- {漬|つ}ける: to soak, to pickle (general)
- マリネする: to marinate (loanword)
- {塩漬|しおづ}け: salting, pickling in salt

NOTE:
Different from {付|つ}け{込|こ}む which means "to take advantage of."
